verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a versioning policy: a new endpoint version ships whenever a backwards-incompatible change is released. Versioned endpoints such as v2 case audit, v2 customer lookup and v3 transaction process are visible in the reference docs. However, the pack contains no documented deprecation policy, so the deprecation half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset timelines and notice periods, deprecation signalling (headers or changelog), independent corroboration of version stability.
